name: AccessiMate – Accessibility Widget for ADA & WCAG Compliance (One-Click Toolbar)
author: BDPlugins

sections.description:
AccessiMate is a powerful WordPress accessibility plugin built to help website owners make their sites more inclusive for users with disabilities. It offers a comprehensive set of accessibility tools and features to support WCAG 2.1 AA guidelines and enhance overall usability—ensuring your website meets modern accessibility standards.

🗝️ Key Features

  • Accessibility Toolbar: Fully customizable frontend toolbar with options for position, animation, and theme
  • Toolbar Position & Animation: Choose toolbar placement (e.g., bottom left) and animation style (e.g., slide left)
  • Bigger Text: Increase text size for better readability
  • Cursor Enhancements: Improve cursor visibility for users with visual challenges
  • Line Height Adjustment: Adjust line spacing to reduce text clutter
  • Letter Spacing Control: Increase spacing between letters for clarity
  • Readable Font: Use a clean, legible font for easier reading
  • Dyslexic-Friendly Font (Beta): Enable a font designed to aid dyslexic users
  • Text Alignment Control: Adjust text alignment for better legibility
  • Text Magnifier (Beta): Magnify text on hover or focus for better visibility
  • Highlight Links: Highlight all links on the page for quick identification
  • Invert Colors: Invert website colors to reduce eye strain
  • Brightness Control: Adjust screen brightness for comfort
  • Contrast Adjustment (Beta): Improve content visibility with contrast controls
  • High Contrast Mode: Toggle high contrast colors for better visibility
  • Grayscale Mode: Convert content to grayscale for focus
  • Saturation Adjustment (Beta): Adjust color saturation to reduce visual overload
  • Reading Line: Display a horizontal line to follow text while reading
  • Reading Mask: Dim parts of the screen to focus on text
  • Highlight All Content: Highlight all page content for visual tracking
  • Highlight Titles (Beta): Emphasize headings and titles for easier navigation
  • Hide Images: Hide images to reduce distractions
  • Text-to-Speech (Beta): AI-powered reading of text for visually impaired users
  • Mute Sounds (Beta): Silence all site audio for a quieter experience
  • Stop Animations: Stop moving elements to prevent distractions
  • Keyboard Navigation (Beta): Highlight elements during keyboard navigation
  • Enhanced Focus Indicators: Improve keyboard navigation visibility
  • Skip Links: Add skip-to-content links for keyboard users
  • AI Accessibility Tools: AI-powered content scanning, text simplification, and alt text generation for images

Accessibility Standards

  • WCAG 2.1 AA compliance
  • Section 508 compliance
  • ADA compliance
  • EN 301 549 compliance

User-Friendly

  • Easy-to-use admin interface
  • Customizable toolbar positions
  • User preference persistence
  • Responsive design
  • Translation ready

⭐ See What Our Users Have to Say

“AccessiMate is a fantastic tool for making WordPress websites more inclusive and usable for everyone. It’s clear that the plugin was built with care—integrating easily and offering real improvements to how content is navigated and experienced, especially for users with disabilities. We love how it brings accessibility forward without requiring deep technical knowledge. Whether you’re just starting or already managing a complex site, AccessiMate helps meet best practices efficiently and responsibly. A must-have for developers, marketers, and site owners committed to universal access.” ★★★★★ (allena391383pity70)

🛟 24/7 Support

Our support team is available 24/7 to ensure a smooth experience with the plugin—get quick, reliable help anytime you need it.

Privacy Policy

AccessiMate respects user privacy:

  • User accessibility preferences are stored locally in your database
  • AI features (when enabled) may send content to third-party services (OpenAI/Google)
  • No personal data is collected or transmitted without user consent
  • Session data is used only for preference persistence
sections.installation:
1. Upload the accessimate folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Configure the plugin settings under Settings > AccessiMate
  4. (Optional) Add your OpenAI or Google Vision API keys for AI features
sections.faq:
Do I need API keys to use this plugin?

API keys are only required for AI-powered features like automatic alt text generation, content scanning, and text simplification. The basic accessibility features work without any API keys.

Is this plugin WCAG compliant?

Yes, AccessiMate is designed to help your website achieve WCAG 2.1 AA compliance. However, full compliance also depends on your theme and content.

Will this plugin slow down my website?

AccessiMate is optimized for performance. CSS and JavaScript files are only loaded when needed, and the plugin uses efficient caching mechanisms.

Can users save their accessibility preferences?

Yes, user preferences are automatically saved and restored when they return to your website.

Is the plugin translation ready?

Yes, AccessiMate is fully translation ready and includes all necessary translation strings.
